findings.note: Trusted-remote match unanchored on both scripts (ps1 regex search, sh leading-* glob): any URL merely ENDING in github.com/happyhippovip/2026-courier counts as trusted, so a pre-compromised origin is fast-forwarded and its installer executed. Anchor to full-URL match.

Write-owned temp files are predictable ($dest.tmp.PID/$$) and created without O_EXCL (sh printf-redirect + ps1 WriteAllText follow symlinks): local attacker with dir write can redirect the write. Use mktemp/O_EXCL.

Undocumented COURIER_REPO_URL/COURIER_BRANCH overrides redirect the trusted clone source (test hooks leaking into prod; social-engineering widening of pipe-to-shell trust). Warn loudly when set or gate to explicit flag.

INFOs: (a) file report can disagree with displayed status when write-owned downgrades (both rebuild/replace only the display copy); (b) Test-SameUser compares name tail only (cross-domain collision); (c) Update-PathFromEnvironment drops session-only PATH entries (tools may misreport missing); (d) irm/curl pipe has no hash pin (TLS-only, documented choice).
